scope: Local static review and local temporary-directory fixtures only; no SSH, remote stage, graph, device or container execution.
review_findings: Current local_env.md parser returns frozen config SHA, gz02 host, exact project/control destination and container-forbidden policy; script also hardchecks these values and ignores inherited NANHAI_* overrides.
--static-check reads only local authority/source; --stage is the only branch to stage_once and actual_transport. No code path calls the v7 runner or graph.
The fixed local release directory must be newly created and empty. UNKNOWN.json is O_EXCL/fsync before the sole bounded SSH attempt; an existing UNKNOWN prevents a second transport.

Remote stdin Python first checks owned, non-root, non-group/other-writable project/control path chain through directory fds and O_NOFOLLOW; it creates an O_EXCL/fsynced lease before any destination access.
Remote final is O_EXCL and read back by SHA, bytes, mode, UID and inode; no unlink or overwrite occurs. Failed/partial/timeout/malformed outcomes retain UNKNOWN and require read-only reconciliation.
observe requires matching remote schema/status, exact nonce, destination, source SHA/size/mode, lease digest/size/mode/UID, and parent-chain shape before marking STAGED_HASH_VERIFIED_NOT_EXECUTED.
required_before_stage: Fresh read-only gz02 SSH host identity and exact project/control path, owner UID and modes; this review did not SSH.
Fresh read-only proof that fixed remote v4 lease and v7 final path are absent, plus a fresh empty local release directory; if either exists, do not replay v4.
Recheck exact script/source/local_env SHA and source mode immediately before separately authorized one-shot --stage invocation.
residual_assumptions: Remote SSH endpoint and Python 3.12 availability, permissions, disk space and network transport were not observed in this review.
The lease coordinates cooperative writers; another same-UID actor can race or forge remote JSON. A separate read-only post-stage readback is needed before source admission or graph planning.
The local_env loader module is trusted project code but its own SHA is not pinned by this staging script.
A successful staging receipt proves only runner bytes placed in project control; v7 runner execution, seccomp/descendant gates, Soong graph, target compile and device results remain unproven.
